sloka: योजनानां शतं श्रीमांस्तीर्त्वाप्युत्तमविक्रमः ।अनिःस्वसन् कपिस्तत्र न ग्लानिमधिगच्छति ॥५-२-३॥
transliteration: yojanānāṁ śataṁ śrīmāṁstīrtvāpyuttamavikramaḥ ।aniḥsvasan kapistatra na glānimadhigacchati ॥5-2-3॥

translations.english: The glorious, powerful vanara (Hanuman) even after crossing a hundred yojanas, felt neither suffocated nor exasperated.
